probe: X2: canary device and B9 facts on the current CLI
method: Throwaway plugin kqprobe under the scratchpad (--plugin-dir): two unforced styles alpha and beta, each told to begin replies with a unique canary token; one agent prober with its own canary; command hooks dumping raw payloads for SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop. One scratch project per run; the style selection written to its .claude/settings.local.json.

hook_payloads.injected_prompts: 2 of 8 UserPromptSubmit prompts begin '<agent-message from=' (one per delegation)
hook_payloads.SubagentStop_last_assistant_message: not the report in either run: once the answer without the canary line, once a stub saying the report was already delivered via SubagentHandback

verdict: 09 §2.1 holds on 2.1.274: an unforced style applies only when selected; it resolves only as <plugin>:<style>; the agent's policy canary reaches the reply under either style; no payload carries the style or the model. Hand-back routing was used in 2 of 2 delegations, so the report must be captured from the SubagentHandback tool input (09 §11.2), not from SubagentStop.
